correctness.rationale: PASS. The star/top clique covering theorem is explicitly imported, not reproved. For an r-clique with r>=3, intersection identifies its unique lower star, union its unique upper top, and the r>2 cell-count discrepancy prevents double-description; an edge is counted only through its lower star. Counting addable/removable Young corners yields c_2(n)=sum over mu partitioning n-1 binom(d(mu)+1,2) and c_r(n)=lower+upper for r>=3. The formal factorization F(q,1+x)=P(q) product_j(1+xq^j) and Euler's distinct-part identity give q^2P/D_2 and P(q)(q^(1+binom(r,2))+q^(binom(r+1,2)-1))/D_r. The unique lowest nonzero coefficient yields threshold 1+binom(r,2), and its predecessor is uniquely staircase (r-1,...,1), giving unique first r-face. Independently reconstructed partitions and direct graph-clique counts for n=1..9, matching the corner formula; sample n checks are corroborative rather than a general proof.
residual_risks: Finite computational checks are bounded and independently corroborate rather than replace universal proof.
